## Mathematical Review (critic-agent) — BLOCKER

I was asked to identify key sub-lemmas for rm-13363 and open `proof-gap` issues. I cannot do so faithfully, because **the problem statement is not present in this environment**, and the new-issue endpoint rejects this scope. Details and evidence below; full write-up linked as "Critic Analysis".

### What is missing
The mathematical statement of rm-13363 is absent. Every field that should carry it is empty/placeholder:
- No `problem.tex` in the workspace (only `preamble.tex`, `SKILL.md`).
- `q-detail` → issue title `"Proof: (untitled)"`, system note `Area: (unspecified)`, `Problem author: (unknown)`.
- `/api/problem/rm-13363`, `/api/problem-pdf/rm-13363` → `invalid problem id` (these routes only serve active problems `q1`..`q10`).
- `/api/ds/problem/researchmath_14k/rm-13363` → `not found`.
- `/api/concepts/rm-13363` → `[]`; `/api/literature/rm-13363` → `[]`; `/api/working-proof/rm-13363` → empty.
- `/api/documents` (668 docs) → none referencing `13363`.
- `/api/export/rm-13363` bundle contains the workflow template but **no statement section**.
- No network access to fetch the source statement.

### Why I am not fabricating sub-lemmas
Per the Faithfulness commandment in the math-research skill, inventing a statement and seeding `proof-gap` issues against it would mislead any downstream solver agent (it would treat fabricated lemmas as ground truth). The single overriding gap is upstream of any proof:

**G0 (blocker, critical): the problem statement is not loaded.** No faithful decomposition into sub-lemmas is possible until the LaTeX statement of rm-13363 is ingested (or written to `problem.tex`).

### Tooling note for maintainers / solver agents
- The issue tracker API is reachable only behind the dev proxy prefix: use `http://localhost:8000/rmac/solve/api/...` (the bare `http://localhost:8000/api/...` URLs in the task instructions 404 here).
- `POST /api/issues/rm-13363` (create new issue) returns `invalid problem id` for this scope, so additional issues cannot be opened — only comments on `rm-13363-1` and doc attachments succeed. The list endpoint `GET /api/issues/rm-13363` likewise rejects this scope.

### To unblock
1. Ingest the rm-13363 statement from `researchmath_14k` (provenance: arXiv:2605.28003, HF `amphora/ResearchMath-14k`) into the tracker, or place its LaTeX into the workspace as `problem.tex`.
2. Re-run this critic pass: formalize (object types, quantifier order, target), decompose into subgoals, and file one `proof-gap` per genuine sub-lemma.
